TET2 × ISR translatomic transfer — research report (smoke)

SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION. Every number, figure and gene ID (SYN…) below comes from simulated data with planted effects. It shows that the software works and what the design can and cannot identify. It says nothing about real TET2 biology.

Regenerate with make smoke-test. Methods: docs/methods.md. Limits: docs/assumptions_and_limits.md. Inputs and checksums: provenance.json in the run directory.

2. Identifiability: the 2×2 example

Gene A doubles in mRNA with TET2 loss; ISR doubles its TE in both genotypes. Linear output differs (I_S_linear = 10 units) while I_TE = 0 and gene-level log I_S = 0. The two-gene pathway shows a non-zero aggregate log interaction purely because the abundance weights differ.

unit dTE_WT dTE_TET2 I_TE dS_linear_WT dS_linear_TET2 I_S_linear I_S_log2

B -1.0000 -1.0 0.0000 -20.0 -20.0 0.0 0.0000
pathway{A,B} -0.3219 0.0 0.3219 -10.0 0.0 10.0 0.3219

H1: enhanced adaptive ISR in TET2-deficient HSCs - larger dTE at uORF targets positive at uORF targets speculative (competing hypothesis) I_TE at uORF-target set at MATCHED p-eIF2a
H2: blunted adaptive ISR - smaller dTE at uORF targets negative at uORF targets speculative (competing hypothesis) same as above
H3: shifted ISR dose threshold - same maximal response, different EC50 nonzero at intermediate dose only speculative (competing hypothesis) >=4-point dose series with p-eIF2a as the x-axis
H0: no genotype-specific TE difference - same dTE zero null hypothesis; the default until direct data exist equivalence test on uORF-target-set I_TE with pre-specified margin
